summary: postinstall downloads and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The postinstall lifecycle script fetches a platform tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz, extracts it, chmods the contained binary to 0755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode where it is executed when the user invokes the CLI. The https.get call is invoked with rejectUnauthorized:false, so TLS certificate validation is disabled, and no hash or signature verification is performed on the fetched bytes. The bare-IP origin does not correspond to any documented @onescience publisher domain, and the server-side content is unpinned and mutable. Whoever controls that IP — or any on-path attacker able to intercept the connection — chooses the code that ends up executed on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
